message:
The other day, we had a little scare when a thunderstorm rolled in unexpectedly. As the winds howled, my family group chat lit up like a Christmas tree. My daughter was checking in about our go-bags, my son was trying to remember where we stashed the extra water bottles, and I was sending over our important documents list just in case. 

In the midst of the chaos, I felt a sense of comfort knowing we had prepared together — even if it was just through messages on our phones. It reminded me how important it is to keep our family plans updated and accessible. 

Have you checked in with your loved ones about your emergency plans lately?
